learning_anchors.label: Introductory / Declarative
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Syntax-level understanding self-teachable in under 15 hours without formal prerequisites.
typical_signals: Follows basic documentation tutorials without debugging
Understands basic control flow, variables, and primitive data types

learning_anchors.label: Foundational Practical
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Standard tooling workflows, unit testing, and modular coding mastered in 15 to 40 hours with basic programming prerequisites.
typical_signals: Uses git commands for branching, committing, and rebasing
Writes structured unit test cases and basic HTTP API endpoints

learning_anchors.label: Intermediate Systemic
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Requires multi-step architectural reasoning, concurrency primitives, and resilience patterns (25 to 60 hours).
typical_signals: Implements thread-safe data access and circuit breakers
Optimizes database indexes and constructs automated CI/CD pipelines

learning_anchors.label: Advanced Methodological / Architectural
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Distributed consensus theory, event streaming semantics, and cryptographic storage standards demanding deep technical foundations (45 to 100 hours).
typical_signals: Evaluates state machine replication and quorum tradeoffs
Designs transactional outbox patterns and verifiable deletion protocols

learning_anchors.label: Expert Frontier
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Novel distributed systems protocols, kernel-level zero-copy optimizations, and global high-availability architectures (>100 hours).
typical_signals: Designs Byzantine fault tolerant consensus algorithms
Architects multi-region active-active partitionable cloud topologies

application_anchors.label: Isolated Templated
application_anchors.anchor_description: Execution within clean sandbox environments against scripted expectations.
typical_signals: Clones repository and runs established test suites cleanly
Implements boilerplate endpoint functions matching existing patterns

application_anchors.label: Guided Production
application_anchors.anchor_description: Applied to production codebases with established peer review, CI, and standards.
typical_signals: Submits atomic pull requests with passing automated test fixtures
Builds standardized REST/gRPC endpoints with schema validation

application_anchors.label: Unconstrained Real-World
application_anchors.anchor_description: Navigates messy legacy codebases, asynchronous race hazards, and intermittent operational failures.
typical_signals: Debugs intermittent race conditions and memory leaks under load
Restructures slow database queries and handles service timeouts

application_anchors.label: High-Stakes Production
application_anchors.anchor_description: Mission-critical applications where mistakes compromise live service availability, data consistency, or system security.
typical_signals: Architects zero-downtime database migrations on high-traffic tables
Hardens multi-tenant services against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities

application_anchors.label: Strategic Enterprise Architecture
application_anchors.anchor_description: Organizational-level impact involving distributed cluster survivability, statutory data protection compliance, and mission-critical failover.
typical_signals: Resolves split-brain network partition anomalies in consensus clusters
Implements end-to-end cryptographic erasure satisfying DPDP Act Sec 12
